capabilities: capture Feishu bot messages as diary entries in monthly files with per-day sections
store images, videos, files and voice notes as attachments
run natural language commands such as undo, seal-the-day and set-nickname
remind you daily when no entry has been written, with catch-up on launch
run the same pipeline outside Obsidian via the npx feishu-diary CLI
extras: Warns not to run the plugin and CLI with the same Feishu app credentials at the same time, since Feishu delivers events to a random client. Also ships as a standalone npm CLI (requires Node.js >= 18); some documentation is split into docs/ files (config.md, DECISIONS.md, autostart-macos.md). App Secret is stored in Obsidian's SecretStorage.
problem: Writing a diary entry requires opening Obsidian and creating a note yourself; this lets you capture entries by messaging a bot from Feishu, including attachments and voice notes.

relations.evidence: Talk to a Feishu bot, and it lands in your Obsidian vault as a diary.

summary: Feishu bot integration that turns messages you send it into diary entries in the vault, one file per month with a section per day.
